caption: The drawing is a monochromatic pencil illustration on light beige paper featuring a detailed, ornate teapot as the central object. The teapot has an elaborate floral and foliate pattern embossed on the upper part of the vessel, around the spout, and extending to the base of the handle. The handle is thick, highly curved, and ends in a decorative flourish. The spout is complex, with detailed carvings and a slight upward curve at the tip. The lid of the teapot has a finial topped with a small ball and is also decorated with intricate patterns that match the body. On the body of the teapot, near the handle, there is a monogram written in script letters. The teapot stands on a round, stepped base. In the upper left corner of the drawing is a smaller inset sketch of the same teapot, shown in profile with dimension lines and numerical measurements. The main drawing is framed with a single, thin pencil line close to the edges of the paper. The entire composition is rendered in a fine, precise style with careful attention to shading and texture, and the only color present is the natural tone of the paper and graphite.
title: Silver Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
